decision_rule.summary: The ledger passes when the Florida point signal clears severe thresholds, the daily product cross-checks rainfall without replacing gusts, the compact mapped context fails distance transfer, bounded precipitation fails as a substitute, and image/exposure/surge transfers are blocked.

expected_ledger.threshold_or_test: pass if gust>=150 km/h, precipitation>=150 mm, and pressure<=980 hPa
expected_ledger.interpretation: The Florida point has a severe wind-rain-pressure landfall signal.

expected_ledger.threshold_or_test: rainfall cross-check passes if POWER/point precipitation is 0.60-0.90; do not replace gust with 10 m daily wind
expected_ledger.interpretation: Daily precipitation agrees with the point rainfall range, but daily wind is not the peak gust signal.

expected_ledger.threshold_or_test: reject transfer if point is outside box, conflict flag is true, or distance>20 degrees
expected_ledger.interpretation: The compact mapped box is far from the Florida point and cannot represent the Ian landfall point.

expected_ledger.threshold_or_test: reject replacement if bounded maxima are all <0.35 of the Florida point total and the mapped context is remote
expected_ledger.interpretation: The bounded grid precipitation is lower and geographically remote from the Florida point signal.

expected_ledger.threshold_or_test: reject loss or surge transfer when image/exposure context is remote and no named surge layer is present
expected_ledger.interpretation: Imagery, population, and mapped features are context only; they do not count Ian-wide losses or surge impacts.

failed_transfers.calculation_or_test: WorldPop 175.658766 and OSM 431 come from the remote mapped context
failed_transfers.decision: do not convert context counts into Ian-wide impacts

failed_transfers.calculation_or_test: bounded maxima ratios are 0.143, 0.111, and 0.328 of the Florida point rainfall
failed_transfers.decision: do not replace the Florida point rainfall with the remote bounded grid context
do not infer observed surge or inundation from this ledger

failed_transfers.calculation_or_test: Sentinel-1 pre/post counts 16/18 and VV mean change -0.744729 dB are contextual statistics
failed_transfers.decision: do not count direct damage from the image summary

criteria.name: Requested JSON ledger
criteria.description: Returns the target family, exactly the five required ledger rows, failed transfers, and final consistency label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for valid JSON with missing or renamed rows.

criteria.name: Florida point landfall signal
criteria.description: Computes the point location, 185.4 km/h gust, 211.5 mm precipitation, and 966.9 hPa pressure, then passes the severe-threshold test.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for two correct metrics or a mostly correct threshold test with minor unit errors.

criteria.name: Daily POWER cross-check
criteria.description: Computes 157.7 mm, POWER/point precipitation ratio 0.746, 14.05 m/s = 50.58 km/h, and gust-to-POWER-wind ratio 3.665.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a partial precipitation-only or wind-only cross-check.

criteria.name: Mapped-box distance proof
criteria.description: Uses bbox [-110.225,43.275,-109.775,43.725], centroid [-110.0,43.5], point outside-box result, conflict flag, and 32.825549 degree distance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct mismatch conclusion with an incomplete distance or containment calculation.

criteria.name: Bounded precipitation ratio check
criteria.description: Compares ERA5, GPM, and CHIRPS bounded mean/max precipitation values with 211.5 mm and rejects using them as the Florida point rainfall.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using only one or two bounded products or omitting ratios.

criteria.name: Image and exposure transfer check
criteria.description: Uses Sentinel-1 16/18 counts, -0.744729 dB mean VV change, WorldPop 175.658766, OSM 431, Wyoming county examples, and absent surge layer to reject loss-count and surge transfer.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct transfer decision with missing anchors.

criteria.name: Final proof discipline
criteria.description: Gives the final consistency label and avoids Ian-wide loss, direct damage, or surge claims not established by the calculations.
criteria.partial_credit: No credit if the answer adds external planning text or escalates beyond the ledger.

provenance.notes: All values are computed or extracted from local CSX-129 package data; no network access is used.
